scope: Only closed failed-child hard-safety attribution and absolute inherited owner deadline, plus version/dependency metadata; original task/scorer/motion/action interfaces unchanged
closed_gate: caller verified actual child joined and parent unchanged
exactly one original START and END for same id
no raw/result DATA/PARTIAL read before those checks
hard_false: Any original listed hard condition explicit false, or physical finite_trace/finite_native false: stop current stage immediately and preserve failure/cost
unknown: Missing original hard evidence, malformed source, or unclosed join: stop current stage conservatively; never impute true/zero
non_hard: Completion/dwell/phase/motion/burden failure alone is not hard false; all 11 original hard fields must be confirmed true to continue after failed child; incomplete task remains unqualified/unranked
cost: Keep original failure, original documents/SHA, original END and all cost sources; prefer real persistent delta, then DATA/PARTIAL/RESULT; preserve disagreement and original absolute index separately; no imputed zero or partial JF ranking

deadline.clock: absolute monotonic owner deadline plus earlier campaign wall stop
deadline.new_stage: min(new local budget deadline, inherited outer owner deadline)
deadline.child_and_parent: all child forks, child physical tasks, final parent control and inherited boundary arm against same deadline
deadline.restoration: 400 remaining before 7 seconds waiting means 393, never 3600 reset; expired budget raises without minimum-one-second extension
deadline.hook: unchanged V2 hook separately restores prior ITIMER_REAL minus elapsed; its original 400->393 and 20->13 fixtures retained
deadline.parent_root_cap: Original root supervisor overall cap and earlier campaign stop still win

unchanged_bo: All original T3 roles joined before hook and parent control; same independent component models/gates; zero exact raw; at most one new grid point through original true fork loop; arms metadata hash change recorded
remaining: Root review, new root wrapper/config/source freeze and explicit real CPU/physics approvals; runtime hard failure attribution and nested deadline not yet validated in real job
